title: meshtastic adapter.h declares payload_buf twice in lichen_meshtastic_decoder_t
description: Found while verifying project-LICHEN-worker6-6fg3 on AWS waves-base (native_sim/native/64, tests/meshtastic_ble): lichen/subsys/lichen/meshtastic/include/lichen/meshtastic/adapter.h:102 and :104 both declare payload_buf in the same struct — once as uint8_t payload_buf[LICHEN_MESHTASTIC_TEXT_PAYLOAD_MAX] and again as uint8_t payload_buf[LICHEN_MESHTASTIC_TEXT_PAYLOAD_MAX + 1U] — which is a hard C error ('duplicate member payload_buf') under any compiler. Verified identical in the local tree, so this breaks every image that includes the meshtastic adapter header. Keep one buffer (decide MAX vs MAX+1 semantics with the stream-feeding code) or rename the second.
notes: Fixed duplicate packet_info.payload_buf declaration on 2026-08-27. Git history shows the established merge intent is payload pointer, payload_len, then one MAX+1 owned buffer; removed the stale earlier MAX-only member. This retains space for adapter_parse.c's terminator write at payload_len==LICHEN_MESHTASTIC_TEXT_PAYLOAD_MAX and avoids ABI/order ambiguity. Added compile-time assertions for buffer extent/order, runtime callback assertion for max-payload termination, and an independent host/Zephyr layout fixture that compiles the public header without the full module Kconfig graph. Validation: strict C23 host UBSan CTest 1/1 PASS; standalone local Zephyr 4.1 32-bit qemu_x86 runtime 1/1 PASS; cppcheck and diff check PASS. The full meshtastic_adapter local 4.1 configuration remains blocked before compilation by the known NET_IPV6_ND/NET_RAW_MODE project Kconfig cycle, so the independent gate intentionally excludes LICHEN module Kconfig; the original duplicate-member compiler failure is directly covered.
close_reason: Duplicate member removed with historical ABI intent restored and focused host/32-bit Zephyr layout gates passing.
